# Two splits: one on an equity account, the other on an expense account.
# `Equity:Owner Contributions USD` −100.00 against `Expenses:Supplies:USD`
# +100.00.
#
# The owner settled the supplier and put it in as capital rather than as a
# loan, before the bill was posted.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.

	type: Expense

	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
